questions.stem: I ________ my key yesterday, so I can't open the door now.
questions.explanation: 本题考查一般过去时与现在完成时的区别。句中出现明确过去时间状语'yesterday'，表示过去特定时间发生的动作，必须用一般过去时'lost'。虽然结果影响现在（打不开门），但动作发生在明确的过去时间点，不能用现在完成时。B选项'have lost'用于无明确过去时间状语但强调对现在影响的情况；C选项'lose'是一般现在时，表示习惯动作；D选项'had lost'是过去完成时，表示'过去的过去'，需要有另一个过去动作作为参照点。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The book ________ is on the desk belongs to my sister.
questions.explanation: 本题考查定语从句关系代词的选择。先行词'the book'指物，且在定语从句中作主语，应使用关系代词which或that。A选项'who'指人且在从句中作主语；C选项'whom'指人但在从句中作宾语；D选项'whose'表示所属关系，后需接名词。解题口诀：先行词是物，从句缺主宾，which/that来相助。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: Many trees ________ in our school every year to make the air cleaner.
questions.explanation: 本题考查被动语态。主语'many trees'是动作'plant'的承受者，需用被动语态（be + 过去分词）。时间状语'every year'表示习惯性动作，应用一般现在时的被动语态'are planted'。A选项是主动语态；C选项缺少助动词，不能构成谓语；D选项是一般过去时的被动语态，与'every year'表示的经常性动作不符。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem:
—________ you ever ________ to the new science museum?
—Yes, I ________ there with my classmates last weekend.
questions.explanation: 本题考查现在完成时与一般过去时的混合使用。第一空'ever'是现在完成时的标志词，询问'曾经去过某地吗'用'have been to'（已回）或'have gone to'（未回），根据语境是'去过且已回'，用'have been'；第二空'last weekend'是明确的过去时间状语，必须用一般过去时'went'。A选项第一空用Did与ever搭配不当；C选项第二空使用现在完成时与last weekend矛盾；D选项第一空用Do构成一般现在时，与ever不搭配。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: It is our duty to protect the ________ for our future generations.
questions.explanation: 本题考查词性转换。定冠词'the'后应接名词作动词'protect'的宾语。A选项'environment'（环境，名词）符合语法和语义；B选项'environmental'（环境的，形容词）；C选项'environmentally'（环境地，副词）；D选项'environmentalist'（环保主义者，名词，但语义不符，保护环保主义者不合逻辑）。解题关键：the + 名词，protect the environment（保护环境）是固定搭配。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: After reading the article, we need to ________ whether the information is true or not.
questions.explanation: 本题考查动词短语辨析。find out强调经过调查、研究、思考后'查明、弄清楚'真相；look for强调寻找的动作（look for a pen）；look after表示照顾（look after children）；find强调找到的结果（find the key）。此处需要表达'核实/查明信息真伪'，是经过思考判断的过程，因此用find out最准确。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: Remember to ________ the TV when no one is watching it to save electricity.
questions.explanation: 本题考查动词短语辨析。turn off表示'关闭（电器）'；turn on表示'打开'；turn up表示'调大（音量）'或'出现'；turn down表示'调小（音量）'或'拒绝'。根据语境'save electricity'（省电）和'no one is watching'（没人看），可知应该'关闭'电视。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.explanation: 考查名词及语境理解。根据上下文，学校开展垃圾分类项目的目标是帮助学生理解保护环境的'重要性'。A选项importance（重要性）符合语境；B选项different（不同的，形容词，语法错误）；C选项difficult（困难的，形容词）；D选项interesting（有趣的，形容词）。the后面需接名词，且the importance of...（...的重要性）是固定搭配。
questions.label: 完形填空
questions.group_passage:
Last month, our school started a garbage sorting (垃圾分类) program. The goal was to help students understand the (8)________ of protecting the environment.

At first, many students found it difficult. They didn't know which bin to use for different kinds of waste. Our science teacher, Mr. Li, gave us a special lesson. He explained that food waste should go into the green bin, while paper and plastic belong to the blue one. He also (9)________ some interesting videos to help us remember the rules.

After two weeks, things became much (10)________. Students got used to the new system. We even had a competition to see which class could do the best job. My class won the first prize! Everyone felt very (11)________.

Now, garbage sorting has become part of our daily life. It not only helps reduce pollution but also teaches us to be responsible citizens. We hope more schools will (12)________ this practice to make our city cleaner.

questions.explanation: 考查动词及固定搭配。show videos（播放/展示视频）是固定搭配。B选项drew（画画）与videos不搭配；C选项wrote（写）与videos不搭配；D选项made（制作），虽然可以说make videos，但结合语境，老师是在课堂上'展示'视频帮助学生记忆，而非制作视频。因此showed最符合语境。

questions.stem: What did Lin Tao often forget to bring last term?
questions.explanation: 本题考查细节理解。根据文章第二段Lin Tao所说的话'Last term, I often forgot to bring my heavy textbooks'可知，上学期他经常忘记带沉重的教科书。A选项是他的平板电脑，这是他现在用来替代课本的工具；C选项作业；D选项反馈，均与原文细节不符。解题技巧：细节题要定位关键词'last term'和'Lin Tao'，在原文中找到直接对应的句子。
questions.label: 阅读-细节理解
questions.group_passage:
In recent years, technology has changed the way students study. At Guangming Middle School, students are using tablets (平板电脑) in class to make learning more interesting.

Lin Tao, a Grade 8 student, shares his experience. "Last term, I often forgot to bring my heavy textbooks. Now with the tablet, all my books are in one device," he says. The school also uses special apps that allow students to do homework online. Teachers can check the work immediately and give feedback (反馈) quickly.

However, some parents worry about screen time. "I am concerned that my son spends too much time on the device," says Mr. Wang, Lin Tao's father. The school has made rules to solve this problem. Students can only use the tablets during class time and for one hour of homework each day.

Dr. Chen, an education expert, believes this change is positive. "Technology makes learning more efficient (高效的). Students can find information quickly and learn at their own pace," he explains. But he also reminds students to protect their eyes and take breaks regularly.

The school plans to expand (扩展) this program to more grades next year. They hope to find a better balance between technology and traditional learning methods.

questions.stem: What can we infer from the passage?
options: A. All parents support using tablets in class.
B. Students can use tablets anytime they want.
C. The school has set time limits for tablet use.
D. Dr. Chen thinks tablets are harmful to students.
questions.explanation: 本题考查推理判断。根据第三段最后一句'Students can only use the tablets during class time and for one hour of homework each day'可以推断出学校对平板电脑的使用设定了时间限制（time limits）。A选项'所有家长都支持'与文中'some parents worry'矛盾；B选项'随时使用'与'only during class time and for one hour'矛盾；D选项'Dr. Chen认为有害'与'believes this change is positive'矛盾。推理题要注意区分原文直接陈述的内容和需要推断的结论。

options: A. How to Protect Your Eyes
B. The History of Guangming Middle School

questions.explanation: 本题考查段落衔接。前文提出'很多学生难以平衡学习与爱好'的问题，此处需要承上启下的过渡句。A选项'然而，立即实现这种平衡并不容易'承接上文的困难，并自然引出下文的建议，符合逻辑。B、C选项是具体建议，应在引出建议的过渡之后；D选项是总结句，应在文末；E选项'另一方面'通常用于并列或对比已有观点，不适合作为首个过渡句。

Many middle school students have trouble balancing their studies and hobbies. They often feel stressed because they don't have enough time for both. (17)________ The following advice may help you.

(18)________ Write down all your tasks and arrange time properly. This helps you manage your day better.

(19)________ Don't give up your hobbies completely when you are busy. Hobbies help you relax and improve creativity.

(20)________ Keep trying, and you will find the right balance soon.

options: A. However, it's not easy to achieve the balance immediately.
B. First, you should make a proper schedule.
C. In addition, remember that hobbies are important for your health.
D. In conclusion, balancing study and hobbies requires patience.
E. On the other hand, study should always come first.
questions.explanation: 本题考查段落衔接及顺序词。根据后文'Write down all your tasks...'（写下所有任务...）可知这是第一条具体建议，因此用'First'（首先）引出。B选项'First, you should make a proper schedule'（首先，你应该制定适当的计划）与后文内容完全匹配。A选项是承上启下句，已用于17空；C选项'In addition'（此外）用于补充说明，应在第一条建议之后；D选项是总结；E选项'On the other hand'（另一方面）用于对比或并列，不适合作为第一条建议。
